subject.title: fix(agents): keep compact tokens whole in keyed multi-question answers (#101722)

question: Should OpenClaw accept narrowing `buildAgentHarnessUserInputAnswers` keyed-answer syntax to whitespace-delimited `:`/`=` and no `-` delimiter to fix compact-token corruption?
rationale: The patch is mechanically correct for the demonstrated corruption, but the helper is SDK-exported and the old delimiter behavior has shipped, so automation should not settle the compatibility contract alone.

options.title: Accept narrowed parser syntax
options.body: Land this PR once maintainers confirm compact `key=value` and hyphen-delimited keyed replies are unsupported accidental behavior.

options.title: Preserve legacy forms narrowly
options.body: Ask for a question-aware parser that keeps any accepted compact or hyphen forms only when unambiguous and covered by compatibility tests.

recommendation.title: Accept narrowed parser syntax
recommendation.body: Land this PR once maintainers confirm compact `key=value` and hyphen-delimited keyed replies are unsupported accidental behavior.
